### :bug: Bugs fixed

- Fix binfile import storing unsanitized SVG and missing obfuscated SVG content-types [#12104](https://github.com/penpot/penpot/issues/12104) (PR: [#12105](https://github.com/penpot/penpot/pull/12105))
- Fix removed team members keeping file access after leaving the team [#12106](https://github.com/penpot/penpot/issues/12106) (PR: [#12097](https://github.com/penpot/penpot/pull/12097))

commit.message:
:recycle: Use DS icons and an icon button in the undo history panel (#12472)

* :recycle: Use DS icons and an icon button in the undo history panel

The undo history panel (History > Actions) drew its entry type icons
with the deprecated icon set, and the arrow that shows the details of an
entry was a div with a click handler: no button role, no keyboard
access and no accessible name.

- The entry type icons use the DS icon (drop-icon is i/drop in the DS).
- The arrow becomes a DS action icon button labeled "Show details", with
  aria-expanded for its state. It keeps its data attribute, its classes
  and its click handler, and it also shows on keyboard focus.

The DS icon draws 12px inside a 16px box, so the entry icon gets a
negative margin, and the button wrapper a negative end margin: icon,
arrow and text stay where they were. The arrow turns through its own
class instead of an svg rule.

Add the workspace.undo.entry.show-details key (en, es) and a visual test
that draws a rectangle, opens the actions list and expands the entry.

AI-assisted-by: claude-opus-5-5

* :recycle: Move undo history panel styles off the deprecated styles

Move history.scss to DS tokens, sizes, borders and logical properties,
and drop the refactor import. The entry color aliases become local
variables of the entry, set by its disabled and hover states, and the
arrow opacity goes through one as well.

AI-assisted-by: claude-opus-5-5

* :lipstick: Place the undo history icon and arrow without negative margins

Drop the -2px margin of the entry icon and the -6px end margin of the
details button wrapper. Keep text and arrow in place with token spacing
instead: the text after the 16px icon box starts with --sp-xs instead
of --sp-s, and the entry end padding is --sp-xxs, since the 24px button
leaves 6px around its 12px arrow. The icon now sits 2px to the right,
centered in its box.

AI-assisted-by: claude-opus-5-5
